				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { te_tax_obl_is_maintenance = { KIND = 1 ARG = 2 TARGET = var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_target } }
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind = 0
					NAND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_1 var:te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_1 = 1 }
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage > 0
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods
					te_tax_offer_cut_leaves_a_bill = { KEY = wage }
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_target value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind = 0
					NAND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_1 var:te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_1 = 1 }
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head > 0
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods
					te_tax_offer_cut_leaves_a_bill = { KEY = head }
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 4 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_target value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind = 0
					NAND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_1 var:te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_1 = 1 }
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons > 0
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons >= te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods
					te_tax_offer_cut_leaves_a_bill = { KEY = cons }
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 5 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_target value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind = 0
					NAND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_3 var:te_tax_bl_got_trade_unions_3 = 1 }
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods > 0
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods > te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_wage
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods > te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_head
					te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_goods > te_tax_bl_grief_trade_unions_cons
					OR = {
						te_tax_dl_g_grain > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_clothes > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_furniture > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_groceries > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_fabric > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_fish > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_wood > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_electricity > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_paper > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_services > 0
						te_tax_dl_g_transportation > 0
					}
					te_tax_offer_untax_leaves_a_bill = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind value = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_target value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 0 }
				if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_grain > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 1 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_clothes > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 2 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_furniture > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 3 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_groceries > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 4 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_fabric > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 5 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_fish > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 6 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_wood > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 7 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_electricity > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 8 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_paper > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 9 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_services > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 10 } }
				else_if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_g_transportation > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 11 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind = 0
					NAND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind > 0 }
					te_tax_obl_feasible_1 = { ARG = 2 TARGET = te_tax_obl_inst_next_2 }
					te_tax_can_obl_propose = { KIND = 1 ARG = 2 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind value = 11 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_arg value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_target value = te_tax_obl_inst_next_2 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { te_tax_obl_is_maintenance = { KIND = 1 ARG = 2 TARGET = var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_target } }
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_maint value = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_trade_unions_kind > 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_off_trade_unions_rev value = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
	}
}

# Applies group IG's offer to the bill (te_tax_cmd_accept_offer, te_tax_offer_effects.txt,
# which has checked it with te_tax_can_accept_offer): a clause through its helper, a promise
# recorded on the bill for te_tax_gen_offer_repropose.
te_tax_gen_offer_apply = {
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 1 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 1 } te_tax_offer_cut = { IG = $IG$ KEY = wage } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 1 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 2 } te_tax_offer_cut = { IG = $IG$ KEY = div } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 1 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 3 } te_tax_offer_cut = { IG = $IG$ KEY = land } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 1 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 4 } te_tax_offer_cut = { IG = $IG$ KEY = head } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 1 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 5 } te_tax_offer_cut = { IG = $IG$ KEY = cons } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 2 } te_tax_offer_agrel = { IG = $IG$ } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 1 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = grain } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 2 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = clothes } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 3 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = furniture } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 4 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = groceries } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 5 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = fabric } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 6 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = fish } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 7 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = wood } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 8 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = electricity } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 9 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = paper } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 10 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = services } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind = 3 var:te_tax_off_$IG$_arg = 11 } te_tax_offer_untax = { IG = $IG$ GOOD = transportation } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_off_$IG$_kind > 10 } te_tax_offer_record_promise = { IG = $IG$ } }
}

# Proposes again every promise accepted under this bill (te_tax_bl_prom_<ig>_*), after a new
# revision has released the pending ones (te_tax_bill_start_debate, te_tax_cmd_accept_offer):
# a promise belongs to the text, and accepting an offer makes a new text that keeps the
# earlier bargains. KIND and ARG name helper triggers, so each catalog promise has its own
# branch. A record that could not be proposed again (the same promise already binding, or no
# free slot) is dropped, so it never counts.
te_tax_gen_offer_repropose = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_arg = 1 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 1 ARG = 1 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_devout } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind = 2 var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_arg = 0 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 2 ARG = 0 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_industrialists } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind = 4 var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_arg = 0 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 4 ARG = 0 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_industrialists } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_arg = 1 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 1 ARG = 1 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_intelligentsia } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_kind = 4 var:te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_arg = 0 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 4 ARG = 0 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_landowners } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_kind = 2 var:te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_arg = 0 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 2 ARG = 0 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_petty_bourgeoisie } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_arg = 1 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 1 ARG = 1 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_rural_folk } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_arg = 2 } te_tax_obl_propose = { KIND = 1 ARG = 2 TARGET = var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_target IG = te_tax_ig_id_trade_unions } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = devout } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = industrialists } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_industrialists_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = intelligentsia } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = landowners } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_landowners_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = petty_bourgeoisie } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_petty_bourgeoisie_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = rural_folk } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind > 0 NOT = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = trade_unions } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_arg value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_target value = -1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX offer_promise_dropped an accepted promise could not be recorded again on the new revision; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# At passage, each group that opposed the bill (score below 0, not committed to this
# revision) disapproves for six months, through the shared ig_approval_effect.
te_tax_gen_oppose_approval = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_sup_armed_forces < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 1 var:te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_armed_forces MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_devout
			var:te_tax_sup_devout < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_devout = 1 var:te_tax_com_devout_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_devout MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_industrialists
			var:te_tax_sup_industrialists < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 1 var:te_tax_com_industrialists_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_industrialists MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_sup_intelligentsia < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 1 var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_intelligentsia MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_landowners
			var:te_tax_sup_landowners < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_landowners = 1 var:te_tax_com_landowners_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_landowners MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 1 var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_petty_bourgeoisie MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_sup_rural_folk < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 1 var:te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_rural_folk MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_sup_trade_unions < 0
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			NOT = { AND = { var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 1 var:te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev } }
		}
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_trade_unions MODIFIER = ig_approval_negative_modifier DAYS = te_tax_opposed_approval_days }
	}
}

# Policy obligations (plan Task 12; te_tax_obligation_effects.txt): the beneficiary group of
# obligation slot N (te_tax_o<N>_ig, te_tax_ig_id_<ig>) reacts once per transition. Approval
# goes through the shared ig_approval_effect with MODIFIER (fulfilled te_tax_obl_kept_modifier
# +3, breached te_tax_obl_broken_modifier -5, renegotiated te_tax_obl_renegotiated_modifier
# -2; te_tax_obligation_modifiers.txt), decaying over te_tax_obl_approval_days.
te_tax_gen_obl_approval = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 1 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_armed_forces MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 2 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_devout MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 3 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_industrialists MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 4 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_intelligentsia MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 5 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_landowners MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 6 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_petty_bourgeoisie MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 7 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_rural_folk MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 8 }
		ig_approval_effect = { IG = ig_trade_unions MODIFIER = $MODIFIER$ DAYS = te_tax_obl_approval_days }
	}
}

# Trust (te_tax_trust_<ig>): DELTA (+1 kept, -1 broken or renegotiated), held within
# -4..4, and the month of the change (te_tax_trust_<ig>_month); the support model's
# trust reason is 10 points a step (te_tax_trust_reason_<ig>).
te_tax_gen_obl_trust = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 2 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 3 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 4 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 5 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 6 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 7 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_o$N$_ig = 8 }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions add = $DELTA$ }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions min = -4 max = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month value = te_history_month_index }
	}
}

# Trust recovers (te_tax_obl_check_month, monthly): a group's trust that has not changed for
# te_tax_obl_trust_recover_months moves one step toward 0, and the step counts as its change.
te_tax_gen_trust_recover = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_armed_forces has_variable = te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month var:te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_armed_forces > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_armed_forces < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_devout has_variable = te_tax_trust_devout_month var:te_tax_trust_devout_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_devout > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_devout < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_industrialists has_variable = te_tax_trust_industrialists_month var:te_tax_trust_industrialists_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_industrialists > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_industrialists < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia has_variable = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month var:te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_intelligentsia > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_intelligentsia < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_landowners has_variable = te_tax_trust_landowners_month var:te_tax_trust_landowners_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_landowners > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_landowners < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie has_variable = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month var:te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_rural_folk has_variable = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month var:te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_rural_folk > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_rural_folk < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_trade_unions has_variable = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month var:te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month <= te_tax_obl_trust_recover_before }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_trade_unions > 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions add = -1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month value = te_history_month_index } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_trust_trade_unions < 0 } change_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions add = 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month value = te_history_month_index } }
	}
}
